subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate option to substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence.

Ranveer never has the habit of making a __beeline __for his academic activities.
solution: The correct answer is: **Option 3**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The word **"beeline"** means to go straight towards something quickly and directly. (सीधे और जल्दी जाना) • **Example: **As soon as the gates opened, the fans made a beeline for the stage. • **"going straight and quick"** accurately describes the action of making a beeline. (सीधे और जल्दी जाना) • **Example: **When the lunch bell rang, the students made a beeline for the cafeteria. • Hence, the correct substitution for "making a beeline" is "going straight and quick". Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 3**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences: • **Behaving abnormally** (असामान्य रूप से व्यवहार करना): Acting in a way that is not typical or usual. • **Example:** He was behaving abnormally after hearing the shocking news. • **Selecting inconsiderately** (अविवेकपूर्ण चयन करना): Choosing something without careful thought or consideration. • **Example:** She was selecting inconsiderately when she picked her team without knowing their skills. • **Immediately responding to things** (तुरंत प्रतिक्रिया देना): Reacting to something at once. • **Example:** He has a habit of immediately responding to things without thinking them through. 40:Tbac, The correct answer is: **Option 3**.
